articles.title: England's Drought Deepens: Over Half the Country Parched as Water Restrictions Tighten
articles.summary: The Environment Agency declared drought across more than half of England on Wednesday. Over 20 million people face hosepipe bans, rivers are running dry, and wildfire risks are soaring. Officials warn water use is outpacing nature's ability to replenish supplies.

articles.title: Dems' Dilemma: To Win Back Workers, Stop Talking About Democracy, Report Says
articles.summary: A new report argues Democrats must shift focus from 'resisting authoritarianism' to economic security if they want working-class voters. Researchers found a massive priority gap: defending democracy ranks near the bottom for workers, while paychecks and safety top their list.

articles.title: Fauci Pleads the Fifth in Fiery Senate Hearing, Fueling Partisan Firestorm Over COVID Origins
articles.summary: Dr. Anthony Fauci invoked his Fifth Amendment right against self-incrimination during a Senate hearing on COVID-19. Republicans, led by Rand Paul, accused him of covering up the pandemic's origins. Fauci, 85, said he feared his words would be twisted to seek criminal prosecution.
